# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Redmond College and former schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c3 P15](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0015), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Pris  <sub>[v3 c9 P20](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0020), [v3 c9 P25](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0025)</sub>; Prissy  <sub>[v3 c3 P14](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as golden and fair, wearing silk attire on one occasion. At college, she initially felt self-conscious that her hat had been trimmed by a simple village store milliner when compared to smarter city fashion.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)_

## Personality

Priscilla is a close, supportive friend with a realistic, grounded outlook on life. She shares humor and laughter easily with her companions, though she can be pragmatic when planning for practical matters like housing and finances.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P23](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0023), [v3 c4 P37](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0037), [v3 c9 P17](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0017), [v3 c10 P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056)_

## Traits

- Grounded and practical  <sub>[v3 c9 P17](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0017), [v3 c10 P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056)</sub>
- Friendly and loyal  <sub>[v3 c3 P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 c3 P14](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0014)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching  <sub>[v3 c3 P15](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- Complete her college degree at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>
- Find suitable, affordable housing with her college chums  <sub>[v3 c9 P17](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0017), [v3 c9 P25](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0025)</sub>

## History

Priscilla formerly taught school in Carmody before deciding to pursue higher education. She visited Anne Shirley at Green Gables accompanied by her aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan, and Mrs. Pendexter. Later, she traveled to Kingsport to begin her studies at Redmond College, meeting Anne upon her arrival at the train station and guiding her to their shared boardinghouse on St. John Street. She quickly became part of a close-knit group of friends alongside Anne and Philippa Gordon, integrating into Redmond's social scene. Seeking a better living arrangement than a boardinghouse, Priscilla and Anne went house-hunting around Kingsport and ultimately succeeded in renting Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue to live with their friends.

_Sources: [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v3 c3 P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 c3 P13](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0013), [v3 c3 P15](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0015), [v3 c3 P17](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0017), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c9 P16](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0016), [v3 c9 P18](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0018), [v3 c9 P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029)_
